package com.x;
public class H extends BComponent {
  static long open(long x) {
    String s = "{";
    return x;
  }
  static long later(long y) {
    return Math.max(y, 1L);
  }
  static long commented(long x) {
    // return Math.max(x, 1L);
    return x;
  }
  void go(long p) {
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(open(p)), a, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(commented(p)), a, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(later(p)), a, null);
  }
}
